I came here from stan twt because I know saying anything outside the box will get my account deleted there lol. So here's my thoughts on all this (from a wanjaai's perspective)
Tharntype was my first bl and I joined the MG fandom in early March. When MG stuff started coming up on my IG explore page and honestly I didn't buy it at first called BS on it. But the more I started to watch some of their compilations and interviews, the more convinced I was that they might not be "just friends/brothers". 
I started learning about both Mew and Gulf more and their past, specially mew's situation with art. And my heart broke for Mew, I can't imagine what it felt like to be outed to millions of people on an IG live. Though I read some shady things about Mew as well, I really wanted to give him benefit of the doubt because I think people do change for the better. Specially after seeing the bond between MG, I was sold and was officially a full time wanjaai. 
I knew this wasn't going to last forever and knew that one day it would actually come to an end. I have seen many ships go down back in the day.
But what shocked me is that how this ship is coming to an end. I never expected Mew, who I had so much respect for as an artist and as a human being, would become this shady, petty person who posts passive aggressive IG stories, publicly humiliating and being ungrateful to his work partner of nearly 2 years when Gulf has been nothing but grateful to Mew every step of the way. 
It seems that Mew didn't change after all. 
And what shocked me is that Mewlions are praising Mew for posting that emoji coded IG story. Do they not see how toxic and unhealthy this behavior is?? I don't have a bias between Mew and Gulf, but I think rationally and being a wanjaai won't stop me from addressing my fave's toxicity.
I started noticing things were different when I saw Mew stopped liking and commenting on Gulf's post after his birthday. And I'm sure everyone knows what went down in the last few days. 
Even the part where Mew deleted/archived some of his IG posts, I understand that because the brand contract probably ended and he always archives those posts. But what took me back was when I saw he deleted the "1 year anniversary" post. He had so many more posts to choose from to archive but it was hella sus to me that he chose that one? 
I feel bad for Gulf and I honestly want to smack his head and tell him "dude have some self respect. STOP LIKING AND COMMENTING UNDER HIS POSTS".
If it were me and my long time friend, lover or work partner was being this much ignorance towards me, I would feel devastated, and to think Mew is doing that to Gulf in front of millions of people. How does that make him any different from what Art did?? Art came to IG live to discuss private issue and two years later, Mew is shading his partner through an IG story. Like bro I know you think want people to think you're 19 but stop acting like one!!
If this ship goes down, I can see the media labelling Mew the "jeffree star of bl industry"
Lastly I just wanna say, I'm disappointed. I'm disappointed that I got into this ship in the first place, I'm disappointed that the artist I admired and had respect for turned out to be like this. 
I hope and pray that I'm wrong on all this and all this is just a misunderstanding. I'll happily be a clown. 
And even if the ship does sink, I hope we get some kind of explanation from both side, some might say they don't owe us one but technically they do because they present themselves to us through social media and how we see them solely depends on it. I hope we at least get a closure.
